verdict.rationale: Retell's API is path-versioned (/v2). It publishes a dated deprecation-notices page covering API, SDK, and billing breaking changes, with RSS, workspace notification recipients, migration deadlines, and impacted endpoints. However, no forward-looking minimum-notice commitment is stated as policy, so this is a notices log rather than a formal deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a stated deprecation policy with a guaranteed minimum notice period, explicit version-support lifecycle docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Retell publishes a dated deprecation-notices page tracking "Retell API, SDK, and billing deprecations and breaking changes" with RSS subscription, configurable workspace notification recipients, migration deadlines and impacted endpoints
